verdicts.reason: A reads left to right as a banner should: brand, then headline and subcopy, then CTA, with the headline kept on one line. However, the NEW FLAVOR badge is oversized and competes with the CTA, the SOLSTICE logo is tiny and low-contrast on the grey circle, the can is cramped, and 'golden hour.' wraps onto a weak second line. In B, 'Chase / the Light' is split across two lines and loses its punch, the subcopy is jammed against the top edge, and the logo wordmark is almost unreadable. B also fragments the copy, with the headline in the middle and the subcopy stacked over the CTA at the right, so the reading order breaks up.
